personalInfo.name: Areeb Khan
personalInfo.headline: TypeScript · Node.js · React · React Native
personalInfo.valueProposition: I design and ship products across the full stack, from Node.js services, data models and authentication to React and React Native interfaces, and put the tooling in place that keeps teams shipping.
personalInfo.summary: Full-stack software engineer since 2019. I have built Node.js and Express services backed by MongoDB, implemented JWT and session-based authentication, and led greenfield React and React Native builds for a restaurant procurement platform, a social-media marketing platform and a blockchain-enabled farm-to-fork traceability solution that has given 5M+ products a unique identity.

achievements: Built Reeco's mobile app from an empty repository to stable **Android** and **iOS** releases, owning the **React Native** codebase end to end and guiding the team through subsequent feature modules [metric: installs / active users].
Rebuilt the company website on a **headless CMS** that I proposed and integrated, so the business publishes content without engineering involvement [metric: e.g. content-change turnaround].
Maintain code quality across Reeco's repositories through regular **pull-request reviews**.
Implemented **session-based authentication** in the sign-up flow of the **Node.js** back-end SDK, strengthening security for applications built on SuperTokens.
Built and launched SuperTokens' public **JWT** encoder/decoder, with signature-key validation across 6 signing algorithms (**HS256**, **HS384**, **HS512**, **ES256**, **RS256**, **PS256**).
Maintained the user-management dashboard and **front-end SDKs**, resolving UI defects and improving dashboard and website performance [metric: e.g. Lighthouse / load time].
Migrated legacy code to the latest SDK version and introduced theming on the sign-up page, working with the UI/UX team to integrate the new design elements.
Led the from-scratch build of the BeTagged social-media marketing web app in **TypeScript** and **React**, mentoring developers through daily code reviews [metric: e.g. launch scope / users].
Set up and managed a **Lerna** monorepo and co-led the shared-code effort, removing duplicated business logic between the web and mobile apps [metric: e.g. % shared code].
Designed a single cross-platform logging setup with **Segment** and **Sentry** to replace platform-specific logging; it became the blueprint reused by other projects across the organisation.
Reduced wait times across Reeco's three procurement apps (Back Office, Seller, Buyer) by implementing optimistic updates and response caching with **TanStack Query** [metric: e.g. perceived latency].
Contributed reusable components to a shared **Storybook** library, improving consistency across the three apps [metric: e.g. shared components].

workExperience.role: Full Stack / Lead Front End Developer
achievements: Architected a **Node.js** print service and dashboard (**Express**, **MongoDB**, **Puppeteer**) that automated dynamic QR-code label generation and replaced proprietary software, increasing daily label-printing throughput by more than 60%.

Co-led development of QRiosity, a blockchain-enabled farm-to-fork traceability platform that has given 5M+ products a unique identity, is integrated into 3+ supply chains, and won 1st prize at the inaugural Inspiring Futures event (UAE).
Designed client-specific traceability experiences in **Adobe XD** and built them in **React**, shipping 5+ trace apps.
Led front-end development of the Invento ERP, covering inventory, invoicing and throughput estimation, with **React**, **Redux** and **Ant Design** [metric].
Brought the traceability module to farmers in Maharashtra through a **PWA** and a **React Native** Android app with **i18n** support [metric: e.g. farmers onboarded].
Developed and co-designed the corporate website of Sahyadri Farms, India's leading Farmer-Producer Organisation, reaching ~10K impressions per month.
Trained 30+ interns in **React** through hands-on bootcamps, from fundamentals to advanced patterns.

Designed and built DhammaEdicts across the stack (**React**, **Redux**, **Node.js**, **Express**, **MongoDB**): a web app preserving the Buddhist Tripitaka texts on a blockchain, inaugurated by the Dalai Lama at the Global Buddhist Congregation 2019.
Co-implemented authentication and authorisation with **JWT** to secure access to the platform.
Designed and developed the website for HortiSquare, a farmer-outreach programme connecting farmers with skill training and incubation.
Worked alongside tech entrepreneurs through team exercises, presentations and seminars to turn proposed solutions to real-world problems into software.
Designed and co-developed an **Android** app and website for an acupressure practice, letting patients book appointments and practitioners manage reports.
